facts.summary: Phase II missed primary endpoint at 24 hours due to underenrollment · Phase 2 · SLS-002 in suicidal MDD · not yet approved
facts.indication: Major Depressive Disorder with acute suicidal ideation and behavior

evidence.summary: Due to the limited sample size, the study did not meet the pre-defined primary endpoint (MADRS ANCOVA at 24 hours post dosing).
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Due to the limited sample size, the study did not meet the pre-defined primary endpoint (MADRS ANCOVA at 24 hours post dosing).
evidence.safety: There were 5 serious adverse events (3 with SLS-002, 2 with placebo), all for suicidality, all judged unrelated to the study drug, and all resolved.
evidence.program_discontinued: We expect to move forward with our development of SLS-002 after the end of Phase II meeting with the FDA
